osaka_wakitaya_nishitenma.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Horumon grilled in a house sauce, a horumon stew and a stamina rice bowl; yakiton and yakitori.
osaka_wakitaya_nishitenma.vegan_detail: Not vegan: offal, pork and chicken grilled over charcoal.
osaka_wakitaya_nishitenma.hours_raw: Mon–Sat, the day before and after a holiday 17:00–24:00 (last order food 23:00, drinks 23:30); closed Sundays, holidays and the 2nd and 4th Mondays (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 15 seats, mostly a counter; smoking allowed; free Wi-Fi (Tabelog). Opened 6 June 2017 (Tabelog). A stamina rice bowl at lunch in January 2022.
osaka_wakitaya_nishitenma.notes: [Izakaya · 西天満, charcoal-grilled horumon] A small counter izakaya between Kitashinchi and Nishitenma, open since 2017, where the owner grills horumon, yakiton and yakitori over charcoal and makes the sauces. Start with the wagyu horumon of small intestine and the beef tataki yukhoe, then work through heart, shiro-maru and tongue; small portions make it easy to eat alone. Prices are low for the area, around ¥3,000–4,000 a head. Busy with office workers after work; smoking is allowed.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: a hidden izakaya between Kitashinchi and Nishitenma where the chef grills offal, yakiton and yakitori over charcoal, with popular shochu; opened 6 June 2017. A March 2022 diner was told the sauces are homemade by the owner; a March 2023 diner describes the owner grilling.

anecdotes.text: "I heard they are homemade by the owner." — March 2022, of the sauces.
"Everything is reasonably priced and there are small portion sizes available, perfect for enjoying a meal alone." — March 2023.
"It's bustling with salarymen after work." — February 2025.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 脇田屋、ホルモン・居酒屋・もつ鍋、大阪市北区西天満4-15-1、北新地駅から5分、東梅田駅から6分、大阪駅から11分、月〜土・祝前日・祝後日17:00〜24:00 (L.O.料理23:00、ドリンク23:30)、日・祝と第2・第4月曜休み、予約可、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、15席、喫煙可、無料 Wi-Fi、2017年6月6日オープン、北新地と西天満の間の隠れ家の居酒屋、炭火で焼くホルモン・焼きとん・焼き鳥、人気の焼酎。口コミ(2019年9月〜2025年7月): 和牛ホルモン (小腸) 908円 (小は528円)、のちに999円、ガツしん、ハツ、シロまる、ハラミ・タン・コシラ588円、鶏もものたたき999円、せせり488円、牛たたきユッケ1,280円、あっさりしたホルモンの煮込み、キムチ、らっきょう、ランチのスタミナ丼600円、店主の自家製のたれ、ひとりでも少なめの量で、仕事帰りの会社員でにぎわう、明るい店主とスタッフ。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter izakaya; small portions for one (2023). No English evidence found.

osaka_kayou_nishiumeda_dojima.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Vegetable kaiseki with a house dressing, tempura, Omi fu, Omi chicken hotpot and Omi beef sukiyaki.
osaka_kayou_nishiumeda_dojima.vegan_detail: Ask. A vegetable-led restaurant with all-you-can-eat salad, and Tabelog ticks "vegetarian options", but the courses include chicken, pork and beef hotpots and nothing is described as vegan.
osaka_kayou_nishiumeda_dojima.hours_raw: Daily 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:30; Sunday lunch by course only) and 18:00–22:00 (last order 21:00); open year-round (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; after 13:00 at lunch by phone only (September 2026). Starter ¥330, not with courses (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), PayPay (Tabelog). 40 seats; private rooms for 2 to over 30; non-smoking; Osaka gold sticker for infection control (Tabelog).
osaka_kayou_nishiumeda_dojima.notes: [Japanese · Dojima, Shiga's vegetables from the farm] A forty-seat Japanese restaurant in Dojima run by a Shiga company that grows its own vegetables in Moriyama and trucks in produce from local farms each day. The signature is an all-you-can-eat 'Omi vegetable' salad, served in a flowerpot and dressed from a watering can at the table. Dinner courses from ¥4,000 add an Omi chicken hotpot or Omi beef sukiyaki, red konnyaku, tempura and seasoned rice; the ¥1,210 lunch set comes with free refills of salad and rice. Open daily, non-smoking, with private rooms.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: an Omi-vegetable restaurant supplied direct from the company's own farm in Moriyama, Shiga, and more than 300 local farmers growing over 100 varieties; four trucks collect from producers each morning; Omi beef bought whole; Lake Biwa fish. The Tabelog invoice number T5160001016157 is registered to 株式会社ガーデン, 守山市 (NTA invoice register, read 2026-11-02).

anecdotes.text: "The highlight was when the staff poured the dressing over the salad using a watering can, just like watering flowers!" — August 2026.
"In addition to Omi vegetables, there were also dishes featuring red konnyaku and Omi fu, which made me feel connected to Shiga." — August 2026.
"The rice is a mix of home-grown brown rice and Omi rice. This is also available for unlimited servings, which is a wonderful service." — September 2026, lunch.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 花様 西梅田、日本料理・野菜料理・オーガニック、大阪市北区堂島2-1-18 堂島NSビル 1F、西梅田駅9番出口から4分、北新地駅・渡辺橋駅から5分、毎日11:30〜15:00 (L.O.14:30、日曜の昼はコースのみ)、18:00〜22:00 (L.O.21:00)、年中無休、予約可、お通し330円 (コースはなし)、カード・PayPay 可、40席、2名から30名以上の個室、禁煙、ゴールドステッカー、Shiga の Moriyama の自家栽培の畑と300軒以上の地元の農家の100種以上のOmi 野菜、4台のトラックで毎朝集荷、Omi 牛の一頭買い、Lake Biwa の天然の魚、Omi 野菜サラダ食べ放題とOmi 鶏の鍋の農家の野菜会席4,000円 (5,000円から)、記念日のケーキつき、Omi 牛のすき焼き鍋の会席4,500円 (5,500円から)。インボイス登録は株式会社ガーデン (守山市)。口コミ(2026年8月〜9月): 植木鉢の生野菜サラダにじょうろでドレッシング、赤こんにゃく、Omi 麩、天ぷら、炊き込みごはん、飲み放題1,500円、ランチのOmi 野菜のおばんざい日替わり御膳1,210円 (しょうが焼きとキャベツと小松菜など)、サラダとごはん (自家栽培の玄米とOmi 米) とみそ汁はおかわり自由、13時以降は電話予約のみ、北新地のドーチカから3分。

cultural_comfort.note: Set courses and a daily lunch set; dishes explained at the table (August 2026). No English evidence found.

osaka_deiribashi_kintsubaya.gf_detail: Ask. No ingredient information. Kintsuba is usually a red-bean square in a thin batter; abekawa mochi is rice cake in soybean flour; nothing is described as gluten-free.
osaka_deiribashi_kintsubaya.vegan_detail: Ask. Red-bean kintsuba, abekawa mochi and isobe-maki; no ingredient information.
osaka_deiribashi_kintsubaya.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 10:00–18:00; Sat 10:00–17:00; closed Sundays; hours may change (Tabelog). Items can sell out by evening (October 2026). No reservations (Tabelog). Cash only (Tabelog; October 2026). 18 table seats for eating in; non-smoking (Tabelog).
osaka_deiribashi_kintsubaya.notes: [Sweets · Dojima, freshly made kintsuba] A wagashi shop under the expressway west of Umeda, on Tabelog's sweets lists in 2022, 2023 and 2026, known for small kintsuba made fresh each day: a thin, chewy skin around gently sweet red beans that keep their shape. Buy a box of ten for about ¥1,000, or a single piece, and eat it the same day (warm it in a toaster if not); or sit in for abekawa mochi buried in soybean flour or zenzai. Cash only; other items can sell out by late afternoon. Closed Sundays.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog listing (not shop-maintained): Japanese traditional sweets and a sweets café; Tabelog Japanese sweets WEST 100 in 2023 and 2026, Sweets WEST 100 in 2022; 18 table seats; cash only.

anecdotes.text: "The kintsuba was unlike any pre-made ones; the skin was soft! It must have been freshly made, as it was slightly warm!" — October 2026, a box of 10 for JPY 1100.
"When I came to Osaka, I heard that I absolutely had to try the kintsuba here, so I made my way over!" — October 2026.
"There is also an eat-in option available inside the shop." — October 2026.

osaka_kushiage_chubo_kanta_dojima.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: kushiage and katsu in batter and crumbs; lunch is tonkatsu, hire-katsu, miso-katsu or kara-age set meals.
osaka_kushiage_chubo_kanta_dojima.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork, fish and egg skewers and katsu, with clam miso soup at lunch.
osaka_kushiage_chubo_kanta_dojima.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 11:30–14:00 (until sold out) and 18:00–24:00 (last order 23:00); closed Sundays and holidays (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; private hire for 8 or more (Tabelog). Service charge: Tabelog's original text says none ("なし"). Cards accepted; no e-money (Tabelog). 12 seats: a counter of 8 and a table of 4; smoking allowed (Tabelog). Opened 20 July 2003 (Tabelog).
osaka_kushiage_chubo_kanta_dojima.notes: [Kushiage · Dojima, light skewers and katsu lunches] A twelve-seat kushiage counter on a back street near Deiribashi, open since 2003, frying in all-vegetable oil to keep the skewers light. At night order the omakase skewers (five for ¥900 in 2025), with Kagoshima pork, whiting rolled in shiso and quail egg, without double-dipping. Lunch is katsu: tonkatsu or miso-katsu sets around ¥1,000 with rice, a good miso soup and a small dish, until sold out. Visitors to Osaka staying nearby come for a first taste of kushikatsu; smoking is allowed.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: kushiage made light with 100% plant-based oil, Kagoshima "Chami Ton" pork, omakase skewers, courses and private hire, "our friendly owner will warmly welcome you"; opened 20 July 2003.

anecdotes.text: "During my visit to Osaka for sightseeing, I searched for a place near my hotel to enjoy some kushi-katsu." — June 2025, the five-skewer omakase.
"The round shape was surprising, and the fluffy texture of the fish was a revelation." — June 2025, of the whiting and shiso skewer.
"The tonkatsu was thinly cut with a light batter, so it didn't feel heavy at all." — February 2025, the hire-katsu lunch.
